newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Milan Nov CPI to be released November 21.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Milan Nov CPI to be released November 21.

text.p: The Italian city of Milan will announce its preliminary November consumer price index (CPI) inflation figures on November 21.
The office which collects the price information said details would be released after 1630 GMT on that day.

Milan is one of 10 Italian cities which issue monthly preliminary CPI data, and the city has a weighting of a little over 20 percent on the national index. The official November CPI figures for Italy will be released on December 5.
